sentences.text: Learned counsel for the accused-applicant contends that the accused-applicant was arrested on 01.07.2025 and since then, he is behind the bars.

Learned counsel also contends that the charge- sheet has already been filed, the alleged offence are triable by court of Judicial Magistrate and trial will take long time to conclude, therefore, the accused-applicant be granted benefit of bail.
4.
Learned Public Prosecutor vehemently opposes the bail application and submits that the accused-applicant has a history of criminal cases; therefore, the benefit of bail may not be granted.

5. Heard learned counsel for the parties and also perused the material available on record.
6.

Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case, looking to the period of custody of the accused-applicant; the fact that the charges levelled against the accused-applicant are triable by Judicial Magistrate; the fact that the accused-applicant has not been named in the FIR and the charge-sheet has been filed and trial will take long time to conclude, without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court deems it proper to allow the bail application filed by the applicant.
7. Consequently, this bail application filed under Section 483 of the B.N.S.S., 2023 is allowed.

It is ordered that accused-applicant (Uploaded on 04/02/2026 at 05:01:53 PM) [2026:RJ-JD:6387] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-46/2026] Mahesh Kumar S/o Mohan Lal, arrested in connection with FIR No.14/2024, registered at Police Station Kherapa, District Jodhpur shall be released on bail;
provided he furnishes personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- and two solvent attested sureties of Rs.50,000/- each to the satisfaction of the trial Court.
8. Applicant shall be required to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
(ASHUTOSH KUMAR),J 52-GKaviya/-
